hierarchy.notes: GitHub-first CLI identity handoff and code-gated device approval with identity kept separate from usage proof.

classification.notes: The route displays a short-lived device code and can approve a CLI identity session; it does not read or move usage data.

ssa_v2.notes: Entry, code-gated approval, styles, and route contract are isolated behind one route boundary.

ssi.notes: The terminal and browser paths resolve through the same GitHub-first identity contract.

sstf.notes: Focused route contracts cover entry, approval, identity boundaries, responsive layout, and motion safety.

spe.notes: Device polling is bounded and the no-code entry performs no provider or usage request.

srs.notes: Loading, missing-code, pending, denied, expired, approved, and copy states remain explicit.

ssra.notes: Focused tests, release gate, production build, and live mobile, desktop, and 4K entry-state proof pass.

sas.notes: Route, component, style, and focused test have explicit ownership.

sva.notes: Identity proof never becomes usage proof and the route does not persist provider credentials.

srls.notes: Device approval requires the existing authenticated server contract.

sev.notes: No secret is embedded in the client route.

ssc.notes: The route inherits Next and React and adds no dependency.

sai.notes: Gen3 intent, lease, source base, decisions, and proof are recorded.

negative_tests: invalid or expired code fails closed

code_budget.notes: The identity entry, approval chamber, route styling, metadata, and focused contract remain route-local.

verification.command: focused auth tests + release gate + production build + mobile/desktop/4K Playwright
verification.notes: The GitHub-first no-code entry and code-gated approval chamber passed without hidden usage movement.

verification.command: focused onboarding tests + pnpm sma:release-gate + Next production build + preview/production Playwright
verification.notes: Five focused tests, 15 control-plane tests, 662 package tests, strict telemetry, typecheck, and the 30-route build passed. Preview 6a5711158589bede5d916629 and production 6a5711f969a5e7026581f9e7 prove unchanged 343px mobile and 1320px desktop layouts plus a centered 2640px 4K identity gateway. Clipboard feedback reached COPIED, the GitHub handoff preserved /account?returnTo=%2Fcli-login, and all runs had zero writes, failed requests, console errors, or horizontal overflow.

install_steps: Connect device start, status, and approval endpoints.
known_traps: Do not treat identity as usage proof.
Do not persist raw provider credentials in the browser.
